confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on a few aggregated sources (Expatistan, Gotripzi, combien-coute.net Spain cappuccino averages), so they are moderately reliable. Beer and cocktail anchors are thinner: Expatistan's pub beer figure uses few data points and the cocktail figure is a single crowd-sourced price. Wine glass was not found in search and is estimated from the local beer relationship (about 1.15x beer). Euro-to-USD conversion assumes about 1.15 USD per EUR, which was not searched. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July 2026 and not based on live listings or booking pages. FX caveat: I could not verify the latest RBA observation. The only official rba.gov.au figure seen in search was the exchange-rates overview snapshot (0.7088, 20 March 2026), which is stale relative to the 2026-11-19 generation date, so the as_of_date reflects that snapshot and not the latest available observation. Verify against RBA table F11 before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Bilbao priced relative to Spanish regional cities and the Spain national cappuccino average (about EUR 2.12, with Madrid higher and cheaper Spanish cities lower), with Bilbao restaurant figures from Expatistan and Gotripzi (menu del dia around EUR 15-20, basic dinner for two around EUR 33-58). Accommodation is a holistic model estimate from general knowledge for a mid-sized Spanish city with summer tourism demand, not checked against current listings.
